agent_explanation: Controller waypoint logic divides by distance-to-waypoint (to compute direction to target). At step 1227 body 1 is exactly on waypoint 2 with ~0 velocity, so distance is 0; next update computes 0/0 -> NaN force/velocity which propagates to position, energy and work at step 1228. Shifting the waypoint by 0.5 avoids the exact zero-distance case and removes the NaN.
